_comment: TNT Library note_block override. The "" variant is the universal fallback: it specifies zero properties, so it matches EVERY note_block state and keeps them all rendering as vanilla minecraft:block/note_block. Each additional key lists specific properties; because a more-specific variant (more properties matched) wins over a less-specific one, only the exact claimed state is re-skinned while all other states stay vanilla. This is the same partial-key + override technique Oraxen/Nexo use to preserve vanilla note blocks. Reserved bombs (twins note=20, smartbomb 21, fbomb 22, gbomb 23, whiteout 24) are left commented for later phases; adding them will not affect vanilla states.
